title: Average Annual Rainfall
credit: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S), ERA5 via NSF NCAR GDEX
method: ERA5 modeled daily liquid precipitation is monthly mean total precipitation (TP) minus snowfall water equivalent (SF), both in metres per day. Each calendar month's mean is multiplied by its number of days, including leap days. Totals are summed over 1991–2020, divided by 30 and converted to inches. Negative residuals within 0.01 mm/day of zero are set to zero for differences attributable to source precision. Larger negative residuals and missing inputs invalidate that cell's normal. Native 0.25° cells are weighted by their spherical area inside shoreline-clipped 2017 Census polygons. Each county requires 95% coverage by cells with complete records for the period selected (30 calendar months or all 360 months). County means are rounded to one decimal inch.
